row.title: seedlife probe test read the wall clock (time bomb)
row.body: test_stages_advance_only_with_evidence called seedlife.probe with the real clock against a verify written at a fixed 2026-11-21 NOW; once 48 h passed the test failed on every PR (red tests-a, unrelated to the diff). probe now takes now= and the test passes the fixture clock.
